_comment: FE UI probe contract — LEGACY manual execution / legacy TEST-PRECON only. Not used in TEST-PREP scenario_intent generation (draft_truth_v3).

trigger_tokens.dxtrade5_creds: dxtrade5_creds=<user>/<password> on same line as TEST-PRECON: or TEST-PREP:
trigger_tokens.fe_exploration_waived: fe_exploration_waived=yes — only after Phase 0b hard stop + operator ack; caps UI depth at shell_only

semantics.fe_credentials_supplied: Token present on trigger line only—not proof Chrome MCP logged in.
semantics.fe_ui_sessions_authenticated: Post-login smoke passed in Phase 0c only (depth_level smoke). Does NOT imply precon_drill or prep_verify_view.
semantics.fe_ui_sessions_waived: Operator re-ran with fe_exploration_waived=yes; max setup_depth shell_only for dxtrade5/webbroker fixture kinds.

required_fe_surfaces_rubric.dxtrade5: tooling_intent.chrome_devtools required AND (primary check or matrix lists dxtrade5 surface)
required_fe_surfaces_rubric.webbroker: tooling_intent.chrome_devtools required AND (primary check or matrix lists webbroker surface)
required_fe_surfaces_rubric.adaptive: ref client_shell_impact.adaptive is affected or likely_affected; no cred token (adaptive_login_policy ctqa_shared_principal)

pass_signals: Retail shell or workspace visible after credential submit
Positions widget or column headers for metrics (Avg Fill, Open P/L, % PL Gross) optional at smoke time
Dealer navigation or Position Book / client area visible
Portfolio/position metric labels or structured absence documented

depth_caps_when_waived.discover_complete_forbidden: probe_executed on dxtrade5/webbroker fixture kinds without fe_ui_sessions authenticated unless chk scope_gap
depth_caps_when_waived.precon_authoring: Post-login UI field names in body require [TBD] unless login_state authenticated for that surface

phase_0c_scope: Login gate only (depth_level smoke). MUST NOT count as PRECON Phase 4 or PREP verification exploration complete.

exploration_log_fields.widgets_seen: Sanitized label strings only; no account names from probe sessions
exploration_log_fields.depth_level: smoke | discover_probe | precon_drill | prep_verify_view — see exploration-depth-ladder.json
exploration_log_fields.view_id: Required for precon_drill and prep_verify_view rows
